name: Redis Insight
description: Redis Insight is the official GUI for Redis and Valkey. It browses and edits keys of every data type, runs commands in a CLI and a workbench with query autocompletion, and helps analyze memory usage, slow logs and live command traffic with the profiler.

notes.text: Redis Insight has no login. Anyone who can reach port 5540 can open and change every database you add, so keep it on a trusted network or behind an authenticating reverse proxy.
Saved database passwords are encrypted with RI_ENCRYPTION_KEY in /opt/redisinsight_data/.env. Changing or losing that key makes them unreadable.
